description:
Leftover. ~/Developer/tractable/.todo-db/archive/ (2.4 MB, untracked, unchanged since September) holds the pre-0.7 database files: standalone.sqlite.retired-20260910, todo.sqlite.legacy-schema-20260721, turso-replica.db with its -shm, -wal and -info files, and an empty replica.db.lock. It is the last `.todo-db` path in this checkout and shows as `?? .todo-db/` in every git status. The files may contain old task text and, for the Turso replica, connection metadata, so they must never be committed.

Decision gate (owner): one of (a) delete it, since the JSON/Git state branch is the record and 0.7.0 migrated from exports, (b) move it outside every repository (for example ~/.tractable/archive/tractable/) and keep it, or (c) keep it in place and add `.todo-db/` to .git/info/exclude so it stops showing. Recommendation: (b), because it keeps the files without leaving them in a working tree.

Guardrails:
- Never commit, push or upload these files, and never add them to .gitignore in a commit that names their contents.
- Before deleting (option a), confirm that no open item or doc refers to them as evidence.
- Do not open or modify the database files.
